title: It's great, but...
text: It's great, but.... I've only had this scale for two weeks. At first, it was great! So slick and easy to get all my macros into perspective. The app has been super helpful with logging my information too, though I don't like that you need to have the app open and the phone screen on to have the macros change on the scale. A few times the bar code scanner doesn't read codes or brings up a wrong item. Now the readings are off about 50% of the time. I have a 50 calorie orange juice for an 8oz serving and the scale will read it as double the calories for half the ml. I have a protein almond milk that does the same thing. The major thing that irritates me though is how all over the place the reading is. I can add ingredients and it will jump up and down. I can bump something, like banging my spoon against my yogurt container, and the readings will jump all over the place and not go back to what it was previously. It's very irritating and makes me unsure if it is accurately logging my macros.
